lava.finding: The crust still reads as a coating on a smooth tube. The incandescent tip is too uniformly red.
lava.implemented: Connected crust and material coordinates retained; temperature/viscosity law now has a CPU test.
lava.next: Couple cooling to the actual viscous solve and crust strain before another movie.

ice.finding: The first CPU still was milky. More importantly, a whole-body freeze switch remains in the scene.
ice.implemented: Closed fracture cells retain 99.94% of source volume; clearer optics and narrow light cards tested. Latent-heat reference passes.
ice.next: Replace the snapshot switch with progressive phase coupling and stress-driven fracture. The thermal test is not that coupling.

foam.finding: The oversized overlapping beads are removed. The remaining foam body is still too uniform and opaque.
foam.implemented: Physical radii retained; severe cell overlap fell from 84.4% to zero in the diagnostic reconstruction. A mass-conserving drainage reference passes.
foam.next: Integrate shared films, drainage and rupture over time; the current packing is a per-frame reconstruction.

metal.finding: Metal reflects convincingly at this scale, but deformation still resembles a thin flexible strip.
metal.implemented: Reoriented inconsistent faces, sealed both ends and validated four closed positive-volume meshes. Plastic yield reference passes.
metal.next: Validate stretch resistance, permanent creases and springback in the actual sheet dynamics.

glass.finding: The first black-stage image hid most faces. The fragments also appear broken before an intact glass stage is established.
glass.implemented: Removed the broad blue transmission fill; tested narrow studio light cards and verified 75 closed pieces.
glass.next: Establish a coherent intact shell and let strain trigger irregular cracks; retain controlled reflected highlights.

crystal.finding: Individual mineral clusters are recognizable; their spacing and scale make the whole trail look scattered.
crystal.implemented: Existing intergrown prisms and mineral roots retained with lower roughness and fine growth striations.
crystal.next: Make adjacent clusters interlock, broaden the size hierarchy and preserve that structure through release.

sand.finding: Fine grains read as sand, but the bulk silhouette remains a flat ribbon.
sand.implemented: Fixed-volume child grains and preview-only occlusion culling; cached deformation determinants are positive.
sand.next: Validate frictional collapse, depth, packing and a real avalanche in a small CPU material test scene.

snow.finding: The mass still reads as a nearly uniform white strip.
snow.implemented: Volume-scaled fine grains retained; CPU constitutive test confirms compaction memory and hardening.
snow.next: Add aggregates, compressed regions and fracture-born powder to the actual reconstruction, without oversized grains.

mud.finding: The wet dark surface is a useful foundation. Its carrier still has no verified mud yield threshold.
mud.implemented: Retained the stronger dense optics. A CPU yield-fluid reference now separates stopped material from flowing material.
mud.next: Use that law in the scene solve and test slump and necking; the existing viscous movie is not a yield-fluid proof.

blood.finding: Dense red absorption is readable. A still cannot establish the right breakup and flow response.
blood.implemented: Retained the stronger surface treatment; CPU optical-depth test verifies thin-to-thick transmission behavior.
blood.next: Validate viscosity, surface tension and breakup in a short moving liquid sample.

plants.finding: Leaves are identifiable and stems are thinner, but the plant arrangement remains too deliberately looped.
plants.implemented: Replaced arbitrary sinusoidal leaf motion with damped response to solved stem acceleration; removed stem thickening. Rod stretch stays within about 0.4%.
plants.next: Improve junctions, branching hierarchy and growth order; preserve the scanned leaf assets.

healing.finding: Actual gaps in the original sigil close behind a traveling front. This is now restoration, rather than tinted water.
healing.implemented: Built original-vector damaged and repaired geometry, localized treatment light and a mineral ceramic surface. Missing area decreases to zero.
healing.next: Refine the localized repair interface and verify continuity in motion. This is an authored fictional effect.

lightning.finding: The CPU samples distinguish an advancing leader, bright stroke and a dark interval.
lightning.implemented: Added the leader phase and selective branch participation on restrikes; retained camera-shutter integration.
lightning.next: Assess the rhythm at playback speed and improve branch hierarchy before a final film.

lightning-redirection.finding: Separate incoming, transfer and outgoing samples expose the routing, rather than showing only the middle phase.
lightning-redirection.implemented: Leader and restrike changes shared with lightning; wider diagnostic camera shows the full transfer context.
lightning-redirection.next: Check continuity between the three phases and remove abrupt direction changes in playback.

combustion.finding: The hot jet is readable, but the localized explosion is too restrained.
combustion.implemented: Depth integration of cached reaction, hot soot and attenuation runs on NumPy CPU; CPU output is isolated from movie frames.
combustion.next: Rebuild the expanding pressure-driven burst. More emission will not fix its shape.

spirit.finding: Transported bundles are more ordered than the earlier hair-like tangle. The conversion still needs clearer staging.
spirit.implemented: Changed reconstruction from thousands of short histories to persistent birth-cohort bundles, with a local transition toward order.
spirit.next: Make the agitated-to-calm conversion unambiguous in motion; keep its visual rules distinct from energy.

energy.finding: Two directed colored channels now read separately; the older version looked like a mat of bright hair.
energy.implemented: Coherent field bundles and opposed localized pulses; a conservative exchange reference passes on CPU.
energy.next: Connect the exchange law to the scene intensities and validate gathering, transfer and release in motion.

spirit-projection.finding: The exact original sigil and its counters survive projection. The connecting filaments still make it read as a beam.
spirit-projection.implemented: CPU vector sampling replaces the missing Blender image dependency; source and projected identity use the same immutable geometry.
spirit-projection.next: Increase depth and progressive separation while reducing the connecting curtain. This is an authored fictional effect.

sound.finding: The CPU wave response is finite and propagates, but its visible witness is too faint and grainy.
sound.implemented: New slowed acoustic wave equation and integrated witness particles, replacing the smoke-like rendering.
sound.next: Improve the illumination and density scale of a physical witness. Reject the present exposure as a final look.

pressure.finding: The inward cavity is distinguishable from sound, but the dust still looks like a sparse particle field.
pressure.implemented: New localized inward body force and rebound with persistent CPU particles.
pressure.next: Improve particle scale, light and compression coherence. This is a reduced prescribed-force model, not a full compressible solve.

heat.finding: Cooling matter is visible, but it reads primarily as embers rather than optical heat distortion.
heat.implemented: Temperature-based radiation on cooling particles, with no luminous smoke proxy.
heat.next: Combine cooling matter with refractive displacement of a physically illuminated witness.

flight.finding: The wake contains finer motion-dependent dust, but its form is still weak and partly feather-like.
flight.implemented: Retained counter-rotating integrated wake; small grains and shutter-length exposure replace large brush strokes.
flight.next: Clarify downwash and entrainment and validate the wake in depth over time.

seismic.finding: The artificial rows disappeared after interpolation. The remaining witness still resembles a granular ribbon.
seismic.implemented: Continuous interpolation of sample positions, normals and wave displacement removes the 420 discrete cross-section bands.
seismic.next: Carry the impulse through a connected solid, with grains responding to that surface and impact.
